_comment: Answers for the community Discord bot (/ask, /guide). Every answer must be backed by docs/ — keep the 'src' link pointing at the section it summarizes. Keywords may include Italian words: users ask in both languages.

entries.title: What is NucleoOS?
entries.keywords: what is nucleoos about overview features cosa e sistema operativo intro
entries.answer:
NucleoOS turns the **M5Stack Cardputer** and **Cardputer ADV** into a real computer, with two interfaces on one device:
• the **native UI** on the Cardputer's screen: launcher, 50+ apps and games, settings
• **NucleoOS Web**: a full desktop the Cardputer serves to your browser over Wi-Fi (files, spreadsheet, Paint, terminal, media, 40+ apps)
Plus **ANIMA**, an assistant that works offline. One firmware image runs on both boards.

entries.title: How do I install NucleoOS?
entries.keywords: install installare flash flasher firmware how setup burn come si installa web flasher esptool chrome edge usb
entries.answer:
1. On a desktop, open the web flasher **<https://indecenti.github.io/NucleoOs/>** in **Chrome or Edge** (Firefox, Safari and phones can't flash: no Web Serial).
2. Plug the Cardputer in with USB-C, click **Connect & install NucleoOS**, pick its serial port.
3. When it finishes, press **reset** (or replug USB).
4. The first-boot wizard joins your Wi-Fi and can **download the SD card content by itself**.
Also installable from **M5Burner** and **M5Launcher** (same image). Flashing again from the same page fixes most failed installs.

entries.title: What goes on the SD card?
entries.keywords: sd card microsd scheda fat32 zip payload content download apps missing extract root contenuto
entries.answer:
The web desktop, apps and ANIMA's data live on the **microSD** (format it **FAT32**).
• **Easiest:** at the end of the first-boot wizard the Cardputer downloads its SD content by itself over Wi-Fi, checks every file (SHA-256) and resumes if interrupted. Later: **Settings ▸ Device ▸ SD content**.
• **By hand:** download `nucleoos-latest-sd.zip` from the latest release and **extract it to the card's root**, so `/apps` `/www` `/system` `/data` sit at the top level. Insert the card before powering on.
The `-sd.zip` is **not** firmware: never put it in a flasher or launcher.

entries.title: M5Launcher and M5Burner
entries.keywords: m5launcher launcher m5burner burner guest ota list back to launcher webburner
entries.answer:
NucleoOS uses **one image** for every install path:
• **M5Burner**: burn it whole (stand-alone mode, updates itself).
• **M5Launcher** (OTA list, SD card or GitHub link): it runs as a **guest**. Updates then come from the Launcher, its own updater switches off so it can never overwrite your other firmwares, and **Settings ▸ Device ▸ Back to M5Launcher** returns you to the Launcher (or power-cycle + ENTER).
To update a Launcher install: put the release's firmware `.bin` on the SD card and install it from the Launcher's SD menu.

entries.title: First boot wizard
entries.keywords: first boot wizard primo avvio language wifi network name setup prima accensione
entries.answer:
On first power-up a short wizard runs on the Cardputer's keyboard:
1. **Language** (more languages later in Settings ▸ Language)
2. **Network**: join your Wi-Fi, or skip to start the Cardputer's own **Access Point**
3. **Device name**: default `nucleo-01` (hostname `nucleo-01.local`)
4. **SD content** download (skippable, a QR shows how to do it from a PC)
5. **All set**: the screen shows the address to open in your browser.

entries.title: How do I open the web desktop?
entries.keywords: web desktop web os browser open address ip nucleo-01.local desktop console how to use desktop web aprire indirizzo
entries.answer:
1. Use a phone or PC on the **same network** as the Cardputer.
2. Open the address it shows (its IP, or `http://nucleo-01.local`). In Access Point mode join `NucleoOS-xxxx` and open `http://192.168.4.1/`.
3. The first time, type the **6-digit PIN** shown on the Cardputer (TAB ▸ Web client). The browser stays paired after reboots.
Inside: Start menu and search, windows, notifications, and apps like Files, Spreadsheet, Paint, Terminal, Media, Settings. Summon ANIMA anywhere with **Ctrl/⌘ + Space**.

entries.title: Where is the pairing PIN?
entries.keywords: pin pair pairing code password web login codice accoppiamento sign out sessions locked
entries.answer:
On the Cardputer:
• press **TAB** (Control Center) and move to **Web client**: the bottom line shows `Web <address>  PIN <code>`
• or **Settings ▸ Device ▸ PIN**
• or the **Connection** / **Remote Control** apps.
The PIN stays the same across reboots; only new browsers need it. After 5 wrong tries a browser is locked out for a while. To sign every browser out: **Settings ▸ Device ▸ Web sessions**.

entries.title: No Wi-Fi? Use the Access Point
entries.keywords: access point hotspot ap no wifi own network phone join 192.168.4.1 nucleoos-xxxx can't connect authentication
entries.answer:
Without Wi-Fi the Cardputer starts its own network **`NucleoOS-xxxx`**, with the password on screen. Join it from a phone or PC and open **`http://192.168.4.1/`**.
If a phone says "authentication required" or "incorrect password", just **try again and give it a moment**: the hotspot keeps the air quiet so the phone's retries succeed. Toggle it any time with **TAB ▸ Hotspot**.

entries.title: Using the Cardputer: keys and launcher
entries.keywords: keys keyboard tasti launcher navigate move enter esc back search spotlight pin app control center tab brightness volume
entries.answer:
• `;` / `.` move up/down, `,` / `/` left/right, **Enter** opens, **Esc** goes back, **Del** deletes
• **Just type** at Home to search every app (in any language: "meteo" finds Weather), and settings too
• `*` pins an app to Home (up to 6); a Recent tile lists your last 5 apps
• **TAB** opens the **Control Center**: Mute, Torch, Sleep, Hotspot (keys 1-4), brightness and volume, Web client, Restart
• Inside lists, `1`-`9` jump to that row.

entries.title: How do I use ANIMA?
entries.keywords: anima assistant assistente ai offline ask question chat how to use copilot ctrl space voice talk
entries.answer:
**ANIMA** is NucleoOS's assistant and it works **offline**: no cloud, no account.
• On the Cardputer: open **ANIMA** from Home (it's always first).
• On the web desktop: the ANIMA app, or **Ctrl/⌘ + Space** from anywhere.
Ask it to **do things** ("open the calculator", "set a timer for 5 minutes", "convert 10 km to miles", "what time is it") or **ask questions**. When it doesn't know, it says so instead of guessing. It understands **English and Italian**, and a bilingual offline voice can read short answers aloud.

entries.title: Use a model on your PC (Ollama, LM Studio…)
entries.keywords: ollama lm studio llama.cpp jan local model pc llm modello locale gpu cloud key api groq claude gemini engines
entries.answer:
ANIMA can use AI servers running on your computer: **Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, Jan**.
Open **Settings ▸ AI / Models ▸ Models on your PC** on the web desktop: it shows what's running, lets you pick a model per task (chat, code, agent), choose PC or cloud first, add a server by address, and gives the exact fix when a server refuses NucleoOS (for example Ollama's `OLLAMA_ORIGINS`).
Cloud models work too if you add your own API key. The offline brain always stays available.

entries.title: Private mode
entries.keywords: private privacy mode offline no cloud data privato riservatezza internet
entries.answer: Choose the **Private** AI profile and every app stays off the Internet: ANIMA, the agent, games and Paint only use the Cardputer and models on your own computer on the home network. No cloud calls, even with keys configured.

entries.title: How do I update?
entries.keywords: update aggiornare aggiornamento upgrade new version release ota firmware latest
entries.answer:
NucleoOS finds new releases by itself.
• **Web desktop:** a notification appears; open **Settings ▸ Updates** to download, verify (SHA-256) and install. Easiest path, no cable.
• **SD content:** **Settings ▸ Updates ▸ SD card content** updates only the changed files; your data, keys and settings are never touched.
• **On the device:** an update dialog at boot tells you where to install it.
• **M5Launcher installs** update from the Launcher.
Updates are **A/B with automatic rollback**: a bad image is never kept.

entries.title: Which version do I have?
entries.keywords: version versione which firmware build number check about
entries.answer: The firmware version shows in the **boot banner** and in the web desktop's **Settings ▸ Updates**. Please include it in every #help post.

entries.title: Change language
entries.keywords: language lingua italian english german spanish french italiano change translate
entries.answer: The whole OS is in **5 languages**: English, Italiano, Deutsch, Español, Français. Change it in **Settings ▸ Language** on the Cardputer or in the web Settings: launcher, apps, search and voice all follow. ANIMA's offline engine understands English and Italian.

entries.title: Games and emulators
entries.keywords: games giochi emulator game boy game gear rom roms arcade nes snes costellazioni play
entries.answer:
• **Native games** on the Cardputer: Costellazioni (space), Tanks, Pinball, Snake Duel, Pong, Yahtzee and more.
• **Native emulators**: Game Boy and Game Gear (our own cores, saves supported).
• **Web**: Arcade (NES, SNES, Game Boy, GBA, Mega Drive…), Game Center with peer-to-peer multiplayer, DOSBox.
Emulators are **bring your own ROMs**: NucleoOS ships none, and sharing ROMs or ROM links here is not allowed.

entries.title: Cardputer vs Cardputer ADV
entries.keywords: adv cardputer adv difference supported boards which board compatible original
entries.answer: Both are supported by **the same firmware image**: it detects the board at boot. Nothing to choose when you install.

entries.title: SD card not recognized / apps missing
entries.keywords: sd not recognized not found missing apps empty desktop blank card error exfat format problem non funziona
entries.answer:
• Format the card **FAT32** (big cards often come as exFAT).
• If you copied the zip by hand, check it was **extracted to the root**: `/apps` `/www` `/system` `/data` at the top level, not inside another folder.
• Or let the Cardputer fix it: **Settings ▸ Device ▸ SD content** downloads and verifies the right content for your firmware.

entries.title: Flashing fails / no serial port
entries.keywords: flash fails error no port serial not detected connect failed brick bootloop stuck flasher non trova porta
entries.answer:
• Use **desktop Chrome or Edge** (Firefox, Safari and phones can't flash).
• Try another **USB-C cable** (many are charge-only) and another USB port.
• If the port doesn't appear, hold the Cardputer's **G0** button while plugging it in to enter download mode, then retry.
• Flashing again from <https://indecenti.github.io/NucleoOs/> fixes most failed installs.
Still stuck? Open a post in #help with the template.

entries.title: Security tools: rules
entries.keywords: security tools wifi ble ir attack deauth evil portal hacking pentest legal illegal sicurezza
entries.answer: NucleoOS includes Wi-Fi, BLE, IR and network security-testing tools **for authorized testing, research and education only**. Use them only on devices and networks you own or have written permission to test; transmitting is restricted or illegal in many countries. This server won't help with attacking anyone else.

entries.title: License and commercial use
entries.keywords: license licenza free commercial sell business polyform open source price cost
entries.answer: NucleoOS is **free for any noncommercial use** (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0). **Commercial use needs a paid license**: niki070585@gmail.com

entries.title: Report a bug or contribute
entries.keywords: bug report issue contribute contributing github pull request feature request idea segnalare
entries.answer:
• **Bugs:** post in #bug-reports with steps, expected vs actual, board and firmware version.
• **Ideas:** #ideas
• **Code:** issues and pull requests on GitHub. Docs for app builders: `docs/app-manifest.md` and `docs/app-runtimes.md`.
